notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for the standard joined-federate MOM HLAobjectInstancesDiscovered value. It uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the standard MIM, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and application class/member names. It checks a baseline-relative total after two application discoveries and again after the same still-registered object is rediscovered following Local Delete Object Instance; it also checks the periodic value and standard reflection metadata. No DDM regions, provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics are used.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM value requests, object-class publication/subscription, object registration, local deletion and HLAsetTiming control, with FederateAmbassador discovery/reflection callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador object-management, local-delete, MOM, callback, and HLAinteger32BE declarations
